description:
Make a command parse each distinct configuration source once across all its captures, so `jit dep add` no longer opens and parses `config.toml` several times per command.

## Background

- The 45d0a971 cost harness (scenario (c)) measures the declaration-attributable time D of `jit dep add` at 41.8 ms on the tip against 21.4 ms on base `369d35a42` (ratio 1.95, threshold ≤ 0.7). The tip opens `config.toml` 9 times per `dep add`; the base opens it once. callgrind shows TOML parses in `ConfigurationObservation::capture`, `selection_observation`, `DataReadSession::declarations` and the `capture_proposed_base_inner` discovery loop.
- c31c2e57 made a mutation attempt parse once per captured image (`ConfigurationParse`, `DeferredDeclarations`); a command still takes several captures and parses each.
- Invoker ruling: a command parses each distinct configuration source once across its captures; the memo is keyed on the captured sources' identity, as `DeferredDeclarations` already compares sources. This refines `b697a3f7` REQ-10 (one parse per image, reused across captures with identical sources); it does not supersede it.
- Epic criteria: `b697a3f7` REQ-10, REQ-22 (story `0672b087`).

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Within one command, every capture whose declaration sources (`config.toml`, `rules.toml`, `gates.toml`) are byte-identical to a source already parsed reuses that parse; a capture with different sources parses once. The memo key is the captured sources' identity, not a path or a time. One memo serves the whole command.
- [hard] REQ-02: The observation, selection, read-session declaration and discovery paths of a command, including `load_configuration`, `capture_initialized`, and the precheck, template and registry-edit handoffs from discovery to `MutationBase::declarations()`, all take their declarations from that memo; no path constructs a fresh memo.
- [hard] REQ-03: The existing owning test for one parse per captured image is extended to assert one parse per distinct source across a multi-capture command; no per-command parse-count tests are added.
- [hard] REQ-04: Scenario (c) of the 45d0a971 harness reports tip D ≤ 0.7 × base D in a smoke run; the lead records the run's numbers.

## Rulings

- Steward amendment (just-in-time-d5, 2026-11-08): REQ-01 and REQ-02 extended to `gates.toml` and to the precheck (`commands/validate.rs` ~706), template (`commands/template.rs` ~508 then ~386) and registry-edit (`declarations/gates.rs` ~214 via `repository_state/mutation.rs` ~976) handoffs, folding finding 2 of story `d675102c`'s sol re-checkpoint review (commit `cea13616e`). One test owns "each declaration source parses once per command"; per-path tests prove only that their path goes through the memo. Library code returns typed errors and never panics, so the memo has no `expect`.
title: A command parses each distinct configuration source once across its captures
